tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje bzhugs so//

'khrul ba'i dngos po 'joms mdzad pa// rdo rje slob dpon la btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje bshad// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'di ru// chos byed gzhan phan bgyid rnams la// dkar po'i phyogs rnams nyams dma' zhing*// nag phyogs bdud sogs kha rgyal bas// bar chad gegs kyi rnam pa mang*// de dag sel ba'i thabs sna tshogs// gegs sel snying byang 'di skad gdam| |dang po smin lam dbang gi gegs// slob dpon ma brtag slob ma'i dgra// thos pa dang ldan snying brtser ldan// zhi dul byang chub sems dang ldan// brtan cing blo che khog yangs la// rgyud kyi gnad gsang nges pa dang*// tshig don ma 'khrul sbyor ba shes// de nyid phyi nang nyi shur ldan// dam ldan lha sngags la 'bad cing*// de nyid rtogs shing smra mkhas ldan// drang zhing gzur gnas gsong por smra// de sogs mdo sngags las bshad pa'i// mtshan ldan bla ma bsten bya yi// mtshan nyid de rnams las bzlog pa'i// slob dpon dmyal ba bzhin du spang*| |slob ma ma brtag slob dpon dgra// g.yo rgyu che zhing gcam bur smra// lce gnyis ldan zhing blo chung ba// khro gdug sems ldan nor la sred/ */tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don gnyer zhing*// bla ma lha sngags la mi mos// lam zab smin grol gdams pa rnams// thob pas chog rlom nyams mi len// rang 'dod khe grags nga rgyal che// rdzun phra ngag 'chal tshig rtsub smra// bag med ldan zhing dug lnga rags// the tshom som nyi che ba dang*// rtsa ba yan lag dam mi srung*// man ngag thabs kyis rku zhing 'phrog /gsang tshig gzhan la smra ba dang*// gdams ngag nor dang ngo dga'i ched// gzhan la zong ltar 'tshong ba dang*// slob dpon bka' gcog byed la sogs// mdo sngags las gsungs dang 'gal ba'i| |slob ma de ni bdud dngos te// de nyid ji bzhin kun nas spang*// gnas kyi mtshan nyid mi ldan pa// tshong 'dus grong khyer gsang mdo sogs// lam so 'jig rten spyod pa'i sa| |sde 'khrug byas mal sa tshig dang*// bkra mi shis dang log pa'i gnas// de sogs gnas ngan kun nas spang*// dus ni gza' tshes skar sbyor byed// ngan zhing sa bdag gdug pa rgyu| |mi rungs mtshan ngan la sogs pa// bkra mi shis pa'i dus kun spang*// dbang dang sgrub rdzas la sogs pa// kha na ma tho med pa dag

/ma tshang chad lhag des chog dang*// des 'ong sla chos thams cad spang*// tshogs 'khor la sogs dam rdzas rnams// dme yugs ya bshan las byung dang*// 'di'i phyir srog bcad brkus dang phrogs// de sogs kha na ma tho dang*// sdig dang mi gtsang gis sbags pa'i// yo byad de rnams dug bzhin spang*// smin lam dbang la rdzas ma tshang*// lag len nor 'khrul chad dang lhag /rang gis ma thob nyams ma blangs// gong ma'i mthong rgyud med pa sogs// bka' bab chu bo mi ldan pa'i// pho tshod nam yang spang bar bya// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// sgrub pa bzhi la sbyor dngos rjes// go log dang ni gzhan dag nas// rigs 'dras rgyas 'gebs rang bzo dang*// dmigs pa mi gsal sngags ma dag /rdzogs rim mi shes btsun pa chung*// de sogs 'bad pas spang bar bya// smin lam bskyed rim rtsa rlung dang*// rdzogs rim bcas pa kun gyi gegs// dal 'byor thob pa don med du// stong zad yeng ma lam du gtong*// don ldan chos la mi 'jug par// don med zang zing dbang du 'chor// snod bcud 'dus byas sgyu ma bzhin// mi rtag pa rnams rtag par rlom// nam 'chi nges med skyo shas dang*// blo sna thung bar mi slob par// bskal pa'i bar du sdod sems pa'i// blo ring dred pa phyir ka log /bde sdug byed po dkar nag las// rgyu las 'bras 'byung mi sems par// rgyu 'bras khyad gsod 'jol nyog byed// rigs drug 'khor ba gar skyes kyang*// lha rnams 'chi 'pho ltung byed lnga// lha min 'thab rtsod gsod gcod dang*// mi rnams sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi// yi dwags bkres shing sgrib pa can// dud 'gro glen lkugs bkol spyod sogs// dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal can// de sogs rigs drug sdug bsngal nas// bde ba skad cig med 'di la// bde bar rlom pa'i snying rul po// 'di ni lam zab kun gyi gegs// thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod byed do// khyad par lam zab 'di nyid kyi// smin grol spyi yi gegs rnams ni// brgyud pa'i bla ma la smod cing*| |slob dpon la sdang spong ba dang*// lam zab 'di la som nyi dang*// the tshom can dang blo dred po// thob nas nyams len mthar mi dbyung*// rab 'bring tha ma'i lcogs tshod kyi// thun 'dzin chag med yal bar 'dor// ma thob mi la tshul rnams smra// de sogs lam zab spyi yi gegs// de ltar gegs rnams ma bsrung na// slob dpon sku tshe thung ba dang*// rang nyid chos la bar chad 'byung*// lam zab bstan pa nyams pa sogs// mi dge sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur// de phyir gegs la 'dzem pa gces// da ni so so'i dmigs bsal gegs// steng sgo rnam grol sgom pa'i tshe// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i gegs// dang po rtsa yi gegs la ni// rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor la 'bad pas// rtsa chen rtsa phran 'ga' zhig ni// chad dang 'chos dang zha ba dang*// 'khum dang 'khyog dang zhar ba dang*// skem dang las su mi rung ba'i// gegs kyi rnam pa brgyad 'byung ngo// dang po rtsa chen chad pa'i rtags| |khrag rtsa chad na kha la sogs// bu ga dgu nas khrag 'bab cing*// smug po lta bu'i nad rnams 'byung*// de la bum can rlung sbyangs shing*// dom dang mi la sogs pa yi// mkhris sna tshogs tshad gur gum dang*// rgya mtshal rdo sol sindhu ra// 'brug rus rnams ni zhib btags pa'i// phye ma 'bri mar zhu bas dbul// nangs nub gung gnyis rnams su btang*| |chad pa'i rtsa sne me yis bsreg

/phying pa chur bcug dug gis bsdam// de sogs rig mdas bsnun par bya// gnyis pa rtsa 'chus na zug che// gza' phog bzhin du gzhogs yo zhing*// sbrid 'khyug tsha shar la sogs 'byung*// de la bum can rlung bzung zhing*// gangs chu'i rtsa la snum ldan gyi// gos sogs drod can dug kyang bya// yang na g.yam sngon rul po'i phye| |til snum sbags pa mer bsros pas// dug byas mod la phan par 'gyur// gsum pa rtsa ni ngan pa ni// dreg grum ji bzhin 'khum pa dang*// reng ba la sogs mang du 'byung*// de rnams kun la rlung sbyor dang*// rtsa dkar nyer lnga za zhing byug /gzhan yang gang 'phrod sman gyis bcos// nad tshabs che na me btsa' gdab// bzhi pa 'khums pa byung ba na// zha ba'i bcos ka ji bzhin bya// khyad par gang 'khums yan lag der// rlung bzung brkyang bskum ran par bya// lnga pa 'khyogs pa dag la yang*// zha ba bzhin bya khyad par du// gang 'khyogs rtsa der rlung bcug cing*// yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor dag /blo ldan rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun// drug pa zhar ba 'byung srid na// gang zhar rtsa na rlung bcug cing*// phyi nas mar snum byug par bya// me dang nyi ma dag la bsro// de bzhin byas pas myuur du phan// bdun pa bskams pa rnams la yang*// rlung bzung phyi nas byug par bya// khyad par chu mda' rdeg pa dang*// dri chu skor zlog yang yang bya// 'on kyang bskams pa srid mtha' tsam// 'di nyid 'byung ba shin tu dkon// brgyad pa las su mi rung ba// rlung mi 'jug la rlung zhugs pas// snying rlung smyo 'bog long ba dang*// 'on dang dig lkug la sogs 'byung*// khams mi rgyu bar khams song ba'i// khams 'dzag rdo rje las mi rung*// de sogs mi 'dod du ma 'byung*// snying rlung smyo 'bog nad byung na// ar brgyad dang ni nyer lnga dang*// li shi nyer lnga yang na ni// dzā ti nyer lnga la sogs pa// chang ngam sha chen 'jam gyis phul// dkar nag drug bdun tshigs mes bsreg

/gzhan yang snying rlung spyi ltar bcos// long na rgyal mo chu 'byed dang*// 'on na u ta sgra sgrog dang*// dig lkug 'on pa kha 'byed sogs// gso dpyad spyi gzhung ltar bcos shing*// kun la rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor gces// khams 'dzag pa rnams gcod pa'i thabs// sman dang sngags dang gnyis mchis par// dang po sman gyis gcod pa ni| |rtsa mchog tikṣa panta dom mkhris dang*/ */rdo sol gsum ni rtsa ba'i sman/ */de steng skyes par rgya mtshal dang*/ */brag zhun li khri sindhu ra/ */btsod dang rgya skyegs lnga po bsnan/ */bud med dag la cu gang dang*/ */cong zhi mtshal dkar dngul chu dang*/ */mdung rtse dkar po lnga bsnan bya// de yang rtsa ba'i sman rnams ni// cha gnyis kha tshar lnga cha gcig /zhib btags chang sbyar tho rangs btang*| |yang na sngags kyis gcod pa ni// bu mo mgo gtsang gis bkal ba'i// srad bu dmar por mdud bdun btab// oṃ ra bhandha ni shū ga dha ra ni si dur swā hā// zhes pa brgya stong bzlas la btab// srod dus sked la bcings pas 'chad// thig le 'dzag pa byings che na// sngags sman bsdoms nas gcod pa ni// ro sol pad rag gu gul dang*// mi klad yungs kar bsreg thal dang*// sngags pa nus can bi ṭi dang*// a mṛ ta dang khyi nag brun// thal chen rnams sbyar dar dmar la// byugs te sngags 'di stong phrag btab// oṃ badzra karma rakṣa dzwa la raṃ sarba tri ni hur thuṃ rbad/ ces dang yi dam sngags mang bzlas// de nas thog mar yugs gos kyis// rdo rje'i mgo bo gtum pa'i phyir// gong gi dar dmar gyis btums bzhag /des ni chod par the tshom med// gnyis pa rlung gi gegs sel la// dang po rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yang*// thur sel gyen du bzlog pa ni// dri chen dri chu bsdams pa dang*// 'dar dngangs na zug che ba 'byung*// 'di nyid myur du ma bcos na// 'chi bdag kha ru 'gro ba mang*// de phyir nad pas rlung bzung zhing*// grogs kyis rgyab tu khur byas la// lan mang sprug cing 'phye ba dang*// grogs gzhan dag gis rkang pa brdung*// rgyab mdun tshigs pa rnams kyang 'phur// gzhan yang rlung bcos bya ba ni// dri chen dri chu 'byin pa'i thabs// sngags sman gzhan ltar bya ba gces// srog 'dzin ldog na srog 'dor zhing*// glo bur gza' phog pa dang mtshungs// 'di la chu grang mang du brdeg

/nyung ma'i dud pa mang du btang*// zan dron dag gis mgo lus gtum// go snyod sha dzā li gsum gyis// sbags pa'i rus khu khong du btang*// des ni de srog myur du ster// me mnyam ldog pas me drod nyams// zas mi 'ju zhing pho ba na// grang nad lta bu 'byung ba mang*// 'di la gtum mo yun du bsgom// se'u 'bru lnga pa la sogs pa'i// me drod gso byed sman la 'bad// khyad par bza' btung ma zhu na// rdo zhun se 'bru rgyam tshwa dang*// pi ling nal sham dung khra rnams// chang gi phul btang nad las grol// khyab byed ldog na gdong pa sogs// sbos shing mdze pho lta bu 'byung*// 'di la chu ser sman gsum dang*// drod sman gsum sbyar mar snum gyis// byug pa bya zhing me nyir bsro// bum can rlung bzung 'bebs la 'bad// gzhan yang rlung bcos spyi ltar bya// gyen rgyu ldog na dbugs rngam zhing*// lus kun tsha la sbrid pa dang*// stod du 'tshang zhing 'phur tshugs gzer// 'dar zhing sprug pa dran med brgyal// 'dis kyang srog la rgol byed pas// a gar brgyad dam nyer lnga btang*// sha chen 'jam dang chang sbyin zhing*// btsos zan go snyod gyis sbags pa'i// mgo lus kun gtum de la sogs// rlung bcos ji ltar byas pas 'tsho// yan lag rlung rnams ldog pa na// rkang lag mgo sked na ba dang*// zha 'khum reng dang sbrid pa dang*// ro yi yan lag ji lta bur// reg bya med cing zungs mi thub// de sogs rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// de yang rlung bcos spyi 'gro dang*// blo ldan rig mdas bsnun la bya// gzhan yang rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor dus// rlung yan kha nas shor ba dang*// lus las rlung yan shor ba na// 'brum bu sha ro bas bldags dang*// skrang po me dbal la sogs pa// sha rus rkang rgyus chu ba la// zug gzer drag po 'byung bar 'gyur// de la'ang rlung bcos spyi ltar dang*// rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor la 'bad cing*// blo can myong ba'i gnad gdams dang*// slob dpon mkhas pa'i nyams myong gis// legs par bcos pas bde ba ster// thig le'i gegs sel 'og tu yang*// 'chad 'gyur ji bzhin nyams su blang*// gzhan yang gtum mo sgom pa'i dus// glo bur na tsha ldang srid pas// de tshe gang na dmigs pa yis// so sor 'chos pa la sogs pa// phrin las kha bsgyur skabs ltar bya// khyad par sman gyis bcos pa ni// tsha grang rlung mkhris bad kan sogs// gang yin gnyen po gso dpyad kyi// spyi gzhung lta bur mkhas pas sbyar// gtum mo sgom tshe sngon med pa'i// sdug bsngal drag po 'byung srid pas// de tshe bdag gi sdug bsngal 'dis// 'gro drug sdug bsngal go chod par// gyur cig snyam pa'i lam gtong dang*// bzod pa'i go dang phan sems dang*// gnyen po phyag rgya che la 'bad// gtum mo sgom tshe sngon med pa'i// dga' spro 'byung srid gegs yin pas// de la ma chags lam du gtang*// ngo bo lta zhing rlung rtsol bya// gtum mo sgom tshe bde drod dang*// lhan skyes ye shes skyes pa na// de tsho la'ang ma chags shing*// dga' spro mi bya nyams len 'bad// lam rtags du sogs snang ba dang*// gzhan yang rtsal snang sna tshogs pa'i// 'char sgo du ma 'byung ba dang*// mig gi mngon shes sa 'og gi// gter sogs lkog gyur mthong ba dang*// rna ba'i mngon shes lha sogs dang*// 'gro drug skad rigs don shes dang*// sna'i mngon shes lha sogs kyi// bdug spos dri zhim tshor ba dang*| |lce yi mngon shes lha'i kha zas// la sogs ro mchog myong ba dang*// lus kyi mngon shes sngon med pa'i// reg bya'i bde ba tshor ba dang*// yid kyi mngon shes pha rol gyi// gzhan rgyud rtogs pa la sogs 'byung*// de lta'i lam rtags yon tan la// dga' spro chags par mi bya bar// nyams len dag la 'bad par gces// lam rtags mthong tshe der zhen nas| |grub thob yin zhes nyams len skyur// gzhan phan la sogs sngas pa na// gol sa'i dbang 'gyur bdag gzhan bslu// de bas rang nyid ma grol bar// gzhan phan mi bya dam tshig yin| |gzhan yang gtum mo'i gol sa sogs// gegs sel rnam pa mang mchis kyang*// gzhan phan gzhung dang legs par bstun// nyams len mtha' ru skyel ba dang*// gol shor gegs kyis ma zin dang*// dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pa// de sogs spang blang zhib par bya// 'og sgo bde chen bsgom pa la// gegs kyi 'tshe ba mang ba'i phyir| |gegs sel bogs 'don rgyas par bshad// dang po rlung la sbyong ba'i tshe// rdo rje tsha zhing sbrid pa dang*// nang nas khams dang khrag 'dzag na/

/gur gum dom mkhris rdo sol dang*| |brag zhun rgya mtshal sindhu ra// khong du btang zhing 'bri mar la// dom mkhris 'brug rus btab pa dag /rdo rje'i phyi nang kun tu byug /gong gi sman yang 'bri mar ni// kha 'jam btsag bcad khu bas phul// gal te rlung sogs 'jug dka' na// lgang bu pi pi'i sbyor ba bya// des ni myur du rlung tshud 'gyur// rang lus skabs su gegs nyung zhing*// thig le 'chor la rlung rtsol dang*// 'khrul 'khor la 'bad 'jam pa na// gong ltar sman sngags sogs kyis gcad// grang ba'i nad sogs ldang ba dang*// de dag gso dpyad spyi ltar bcos// 'bras bu skrang zhing gnyan srin sogs// ldang na de yang gso rig ni// spyi la man ngag gnad kyis bcos// gzhan lus phyag rgya bsten pa'i tshe// thog mar phyag rgya dbang sdud ni// thang khrom dang ni ra dug pa'i// rtsa ba cung zad bsres pa yi// da byid mthe bong tshad tsam pa// zhib btags rang gi mchil ma dang*// lce yi zhag dang snabs dang ni// sna yi dri ma snying ga yi// dri ma rnams bsres gsang sngags 'di// stong bzlas rig ma'i khong du gtang*// se se ra rā hrīḥ zhes btab ltor btang dbang du 'dus// rig mar gzhan gyis spyad dogs na// padma rgyas 'debs bsrung ba ni/ */sa dmar la gnas rmigs bu'i ro/ */ba dmar phru ma gnyis po ni/ */bsregs pa'i gzhob dang rang gi khams// rig ma'i rakta mtshal dang sbyar// rnam snang mi bskyod pa bsres pas// rig ma'i rkang lag mthil bzhi po// ma gtogs gang du thig mtshan sogs// bris pa snyoms 'jug ma byas par// rkyen gzhan gang gis mi 'jig go// gad dmar la gnas rmigs bu'i ro// rdza nang du ba ma shor bsregs// thal ba dang ni khams dkar dmar// rang gi dri chu dang sbyar bas// rgyas gdab snyoms 'jug ma gtogs pa// 'byung bzhi rkyen gyis kyang mi 'jig /rgya nag stong khun rgyal po'i lugs// de nas rtsa sne 'tshol ba'i rdzas// mgron bu bu ma tsha la ni// btul ma sbrang rgod gsum sbyar bas// chang zhim nying khu dang sbyar ba// padmar byugs pas rtsa sne rnams// ring du song bas rnyed par 'gyur// snyoms 'jug dus su dbu ma dang*// dbu ma sprod pa shin tu gces// de nas rtsa sne mi 'bros shing*// rtsa kha 'byed pa'i man ngag ni// thang khrom chu ni rab gar ba// lcags slang tshan mo'i nang du blug

/rten 'brel snying po bzla bzhin dkrug /bskams nas phye mar song ba dang*// sbrang rtsi dang sbyar rtsa la byug /de yis rtsa kha phye nas ni// rtsa sne nar gyis 'byung bar 'gyur// de la thug pas mi 'bros so// 'di ni bla ma nā ro pa'i// man ngag yin no gces par zung*// phyag rgya'i padma rgya che na// chung zhing drod dang ldan pa'i thabs// byi la'i gzhang tshil dag dang ni// dpyid ka'i lcam pa kha ma 'bus// de yi rtsa ba bsdus pa ni// khaṇḍa dang ni mchil pa'i sha// chu phor gang du gdus zhu dang*// dom mkhris dong ga mar rnying sbyar// sa ti thaṃ/ pa ti thaṃ/ ra ti thaṃ/ padma rakta kha thaṃ/ zhes pa 'bum bzlas rdzas la btab// padma'i nang dang 'gram la byug /nyi mas bsregs pas zum pa dang*// shin tu dam par 'gyur ba yin// de steng rgod khrag te lo'i sha// bsres na shin tu rub par 'gyur// che bar 'dod na 'khrig pa ni// spyad pa'i chu yis yang yang byug /yang gcig rdo rje chung ba na// da byid sha dang mchil pa'i sha// sdig srin rnams ni zho re re// cha mnyam zhib btags sbrang dang sbyar// de steng rgya tshwa lcam pa'i 'bru// chur sbyar lto stong btang ba na// rdo rje rab tu rgyas par 'gyur// log non byang bul rgya skyegs dang*// tshwa la zho re zhib btags la// zhun mkhan chus sbrus ril bu ni// sran ma tsam dril btang bas non// 'di yang paṇa chen nā ro'i lugs// yang gcig phyag rgya rang nyid la// nye ba'i rdzas ni 'di lta ste// mchil pa'i sgo nga'i ser thig dang*| |a ru pi ling mtshur nag dag /bzhi cha mnyam pa rtsi bzhin btag /sbrang sbyar spyod dus rdo rje yi// mgul byug spyad na rig ma de// snying la zin te 'bral mi phod// 'di ni slob dpon padma'i lugs// khyi yi lce'am rdo rje dang*// ldong ros ru rta phug ron brun// sbrang sbyar rdo rje la byugs nas// spyad na rdo rje mkhrang ba dang*// phyag rgya rang min gzhan dag la// mi dga' bdag gi phyi bzhin 'brang*// 'di ni grub chen nag po pa'i// man ngag zab mo'i gnad yin no// chags med chags pa bskyed pa'i thabs// ba glang rwa co'i man ngag ni// zab phyir bla ma'i thugs la gab// da ni lus zungs stobs bskyed pa'i// rdzas sbyor bdag gis bshad par bya// rdzas drug seṅge'i sbyor ba ni// da byid mchil pa rtsang pa dang*| |a ru gser mdog cong zhi dang*// sbrang dkar sbyar ba'i phye ma ni// thur mgo gsum re chang nying khu// phor pa rer btab gtong ba dang*// sdon 'gro zhag gcig lto 'gugs shing*| |rjes su zhag gcig zas zhun 'don// ring na log non bud med kyi// chu ngan btung bas myur du zhi// yang gcig gze ma bzhi sbyor gyis// khams rgyas bkrag legs nad zhi zhing*| |tshe ring la sogs don mang 'grub// zab phyir sbyor ba thugs la gab// yang gcig ra lug 'bras bu ni// 'o mar btsos dang mchil pa'i klad// cong zhi bu ram sbyar ril bu// ra dkar ba dmar 'o mas phul// lto stong btang bas 'dod pa rem// sa bon mang zhing gzi mdangs che'o// ra dang ba yi 'o ma dang*// mkhris pa sna tshogs rab sbyar ba// yun du rkang mthil la byug na// dwangs ma mang zhing rgyas par 'gyur// bud med kyi ni mngal khrag dang*// rang gi rmongs spu gnyis bsres pas// bud med mal 'og bcug pa na// de nyid du ni rdo rje ldang*| |'di rnams bla ma phag gru'i lugs// rmigs bu gangs sbal rgya tshwa rtsang pa dang*// rgya mchil kha shog pa rnams ma rul ba// zhib btags bur sbrang sbyar ba'i ril bu ni// skyes pa'i mtheb tsam nam langs bya 'bring dus// g.yer mas rtsa sgo phye la ril bu gtang*// chang gis phul zhing dal la spyod lam gzab// dkar gsum dag dang sngo tshod sha rul dang*// chang skyur rul suungs can kun dus der spang*// des ni skra dkar gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing*// lo brgya lon pa'ang bud med spyod par nus// dbang po rabs chad yin yang bu rnyed 'gyur// de sogs yon tan mtha' yas 'byung bas na// rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas bzhed pa'i mchog

/pi pi ling dang na le sham// khyi yi 'bras bu zhib btags pa// sbrang sbyar rdo rjer byugs spyad na| |dkrug kyang thig le 'chor mi srid// ga pur mngal khrag tsandan dmar// sbrang sbyar rdo rjer byugs spyad na// dbyug pas brdungs kyang 'bral mi phod// rang byung rdo rje'i khyad chos so| |yang ni srid srung thig le ni// mi 'chor khyad du mgron bu dag /bu ma dmig ma phug pa'i nang*// dngul chu sran ma tsam zhig dang*// sbrang rtsi thigs gcig thig le ni// dkar dmar cha mnyam blugs byas pa'i// kha srub spra tshil gyis bcad pa// rdzas rnams mi 'chor dam par bya// de ni sbyor tshe rang nyid kyi// lce 'og bcug cing srad bu ni// sum bsgril dag la sngags 'di btab// oṃ hā ra hā ra bhandha bhandha tri sū tra dha ra siddhārtha swā hā/ sum brgya bzlas pa rang sked bcing*// thig le mi 'chor srid mi 'byung*// yang gcig mgron bu 'ga' zung zhig /chur blugs raksha gdong drug gis// bzung bas khab len rdo nyid kyis// khab bzung lta bur mgron bu yang*// gyen du raksha la 'byar bas// de nang pa ra ra sa blug /kha mtshams spra tshil gyis bcad pa// dar skud btags pa snyoms 'jug tshe// mgron bu rang gi lce 'og bcug /dar skud rtse mo phyag rgya yi// so yis bzung bas 'chor mi srid// yang na gong gi mgron bu der// dngul chu dug bral pad raktar// oṃ ṇi hūm̐ ṇi hūm̐ ṇi ma hūm̐// zhes pa 'bum btab mgron nang blug /kha mtshams rang gi rkang dreg dang*// spra tshil gyis bcad dar skud ni// kha dog lnga btags snyoms 'jug tshe// mgron bu rang gi lce 'og bcug /dar skud phyag rgya'i sos bzung na// bskal brgyar bsrubs kyang byang chub sems| |yum gyi mkha' ru mi ltung ba// karsha pa ṇi'i man ngag rnams// zhang dang o rgyan pa yi lugs// yang gcig bde 'phel rdzas sngags ni// khyi yi rdo rje sbrang rgod dang*// g.yer chen sbyar la gsang sngags 'di// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ dzambha mo har la swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa' yid la bring bring mngal gyi srin bu slong zhig rung ni swā hā/ stong bzlas phyag rgya'i padma dang*// nu ma snying kha rnams su byug /rang gi rnam lnga dang bsres te// rang gi rdo rje la byugs te// spyad na 'bral mi phod pa dang*// bde ba mi bzod 'bar ba ni// bde ba rta skad 'tsher ba 'byung*// 'grol na/ oṃ pra pañtsa ya du ru du ru he he shig shig swā hā/ zhes bzlas spyad pas grol lo zhes// 'gro mgon phag mo gru pas gsungs// ga pur dung khra khyi yi mje| |zo sha sbrang rgod da li dang*// rgya skyegs ldum bu re ral dang*// te so lhang dkar rgya g.yer dang*// rgyam tshwa rang gi srin lag khrag /sbyar ba rdo rje la byugs nas// spyad na bde ba bsam mi khyab// lhan skyes rang zhal mthong ngo zhes// paṇa chen a mo gha badzras// bzhed don snying po bris pa yin// gzhan yang thabs lam zab mo'i gnad// bod 'dir nyin skar ltar dkon yang*// khams dang bde 'phel sman rdzas sngags// gdams pa mang du 'byung rnams kyi// zab gnad gang 'os dag gis bskangs// des na bde stong lhan skyes kyi// ye shes mngon du byed par 'gyur// thabs lam nyams su len pa'i mis// rtag tu bud med mi smad cing*// rang lus gzhan lus nyams su blang*// chags bskyed 'dod yon lnga la sbyang*// sman rdzas bcud can zas rnams bsten// sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*// stong nyid sgom pa 'bral mi bya// gsang mchod 'bul zhing 'du shes gsum// me brjed rtag tu yid la dran// rtsa thig rlung la gegs byung ngam// dam sel nyams chag byung ba'am// mkha' 'gro 'khrug pa'i ltas byung na// phyag rgyas gtso byas bud med ni// bdun la tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa bya// yon dang mchod pas mnyes par bya// dus kun bud med la gus pa// bud med mthong ngo cog rnams la// yid kyis snyoms 'jug gsang spyod bya// byang sems gtong ba'i dus min par// shor na phyag rgya'i padma nas// rang lces blangs la mid par bya'o// yang gcig thig le 'bebs dka' na// lcam pa'i rtsa lo rgya tshwa dang*// sdig srin sbyar ba'i thang btang bas// thig le chu ltar 'brub par 'gyur// rang lus gzhan lus gnyis ka'i rjes// theg chen smon lam 'di ltar gdab// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'di la brten nas/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad mnyes shing thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi chos la longs spyod par gyur cig /'dod yon grogs su 'char bar gyur cig /spang bya gnyen por longs spyod par gyur cig /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god cing gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don rgyun chad med pa byed nus par gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam rgya chen dang*// bden stobs shis brjod la sogs ni// gsang sngags spyi 'gro lta bur bya// de ni rtsa rlung steng 'og sgo'i// lam zab gdams pa'i gegs sel rnams// mdor bsdus snying byang dmar khrid rdzogs// sa ma ya// gnyis pa rdzogs rim phyag rgya che// mnyam yangs mtha' bral gegs sel ni// zhi gnas sgom tshe 'gyu dran rgod// skad cig mi gnas 'phro rgod che// de tshe mig dang sna bug rlung*// rtse gcig sems la bsgril ba na// gnas pa'i cha shas rnyed par 'gyur// gnas pa 'thug po brgyal ba na// zhi gnas lteng po skyon can ni// spos dang rol mo'i skad la sogs// dal zhing thabs mkhas dag gis sad// bying na spyi bor thig le dkar// 'od bcas de la sems gtad cing*// rgod na gsang bar thig le nag /'od bcas sems gtad brtan par 'gyur// sems 'phro snying mi dga' ba la// bla ma snying gi dbus su sgoms// smyo 'bog snying rlung la sogs la// gso dpyad spyi ltar zas sman bsten// dus bab drug bdun dkar nag mtshams// me yis bsregs pas bde bar 'gyur// lhag mthong sgom tshe gang zag gi// bdag nyid brtag pa la sogs gegs// de ni gang zag bdag med kyi// sgom stobs nyams len gnad kyis bcos// chos kyi bdag nyid brtag pa sogs// sgom gyi gegs kyang 'khor 'das chos// rtag min bdag med rdo rje yi// nyams len gnad kyi so tshis skyungs| |gzhan yang stong nyid kha yan zhes// byung rgyal rgyu 'bras khyad gsod na// de la theg gsum thun mong lam// zhib tu dpyad pas gegs dang bral// stong nyid thal byung zhes bya ba| |chos kun grub ma myong ngo zhes// smra la mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i// lta ba mchog gis gegs de bcom// stong nyid nag po kha 'byams zhes// thams cad med do stong pa nyid// yin zhes smra la kun rdzob kyi// bden pa bshad la de nyid brjod// stong zhing 'dzin pa can zhes pa// thams cad grub par sems pa la// don dam bden pa med dgag gis// de yi 'dzin rtog rtsad nas gcad// stong nyid rgyas 'debs zhes bya ba// thams cad ma grub stong ba nyid// bdag dang chos rnams bdag med ces// smra la yod med min pa sogs// mtha' bzhi bral ba'i dbu ma yis// de yi 'jig tshogs lta ba 'joms// stong nyid dpyad sgom zhes bya ba// chos kun ngo bos stong pa sogs// chos kyi de nyid yin lugs rnams// dpe mthong lung rigs kyis brtags nas// sgom stobs nyams myong mi byed par// blos byas can gyi log lta la// mtha' dpyod dgag sgrub du ma yis// tshar gcod byed pa gnad che zhing*// dpyad sgom rang blos thag bcad nas// nyams len myong grub mi byed la// sgom chen 'byung ba nyin skar tsam// de sogs skyon can stong nyid rnams// sun phyung tshar bcad tshad mar sbyar// gzhan yang sgom chen kun gyi gegs// log 'dod nga rgyal khengs pa dang*// chos brgyad che ba ches mang bas// de tshe bla ma lhar bcas la// mos gus bcas shing dbang bskur zhu// dman sa bzung zhing khengs pa bskyung*// chos brgyad gdon gyi las yin spang*// rtag tu bla mar mos gus dang*// sems can kun la snying brtse zhing*// byang chub sems dang 'bral mi bya// bla ma la gus byang sems ldan// stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug

/bag ldan nga rgyal dang bral zhing*// chos brgyad spangs nas brtson 'grus brtsam// rtag tu dam tshig bsrung ba ste// de dag rnams dang ldan pa la// shor gol gegs sogs 'byung mi srid// mdor bsdus snying por dril ba na// mtha' bzhi bral ba'i lta ba ni// lam zab 'di yi lta ba ste| |chos kun gyi ni lta ba rnams// 'di las gzhan yod ma yin no// bzang ngan re dogs gnyis 'dzin dang*// bral ba'i rjes med spyod pa ni// zab lam 'di yi spyod pa yin// chos byed spyod pa 'di nyid las// spyod pa gzhan yod ma yin no// gang shar ngo bo 'dzin med du// skyong ba lam 'di'i sgom pa yin// 'di las bsgom bya gzhan yod pa// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs so// de ltar lta sgom spyod pa rnams// zung 'brel sgo nas nyams su blang*// gzhan yang phyag chen sgom pa'i tshe// shor gol la sogs gegs kyi tshogs// gang zag so so'i rtsa khams dang*// lus kyi chags lugs rig pa'i rtsal// de sogs rnam pa mtha' yas phyir// 'dir brjod lang bar mi 'gyur bas// dad brtson ldan pa'i slob ma la// nyams myong byin rlabs ldan pa yi// bla mas rang myong dang sbyar nas// gang 'dul thabs kyis gegs sel zhing*// yang dag lam la dkri bar bya// de ltar gegs sel gnad kyi ni// gdams pa snying byang mdo tsam gyi// rjes su srung mtshams bstan pa yang*// smin lam dbang gi dam tshig tu// bslab gsum bcas pa la gnas shing*// rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag dang*// rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa yi// dam srung nyams na myur du bcos// bla sgrub bzhi yi dam tshig tu// rtag tu rtsa ba'i bla ma la// ltem rkyang med pa'i mos gus bya// rang dang dbang chos 'brel med pa'i// bla ma kun la phyag mi btsal// nyams len chag med sgom pa dang*// kun la dag snang phyogs med sbyang*// dam chos kun la mi smod cing*// stong nyid snying rje byang sems gsum// zung 'jug sgom pa dang bcas pa'i// dam tshig drug po 'di las ni// 'das na rtsa ba rul ba yi// ljon shing dang mtshungs 'bras mi smin// steng sgo'i dam tshig gtum mo'i skabs// bshad zin rnams las mi 'da' zhing*// rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor la 'bad bya// 'og sgo'i dam tshig bsrung ba yang*// smin lam dbang dang mtshungs par srungs// mnyam yangs mtha' bral dam tshig tu// 'dzin chags spangs shing gang shar skyongs// chags zhen a 'thas 'khrul pa spang*// mtha' bral lta ba'i rgyas 'debs bya// gegs sel rnams kyi dam tshig tu// rtag tu gzhan phan lhur bya zhing*// ma nus nad pa sprang po dang*// mkhas dman la sogs sems can kun// bstan la gnod cing bla mar 'tshe// zhing bcu tshang ba ma gtogs pa'i// sems can yin no cog rnams la// nus tshad kyis ni sman par bya// las mtha' rnams kyi dam tshig tu// sgrub la brtson zhing bsad pa dang*// the tshom yid gnyis spangs byas nas// smin grol gdams pa mthar phyin nas// spyad par bya yi de las gzhan// smin lam ma thob grol byed kyi// bskyed rdzogs ma bsgoms sngags ma bzlas// des ni las mtha' nyams blangs na// rang gzhan phung las gzhan du bas// des na de lta'i dam tshig rnams// srung sdom tshul bzhin bgyis pa na// dgos dgu 'byung ngo 'bad par byos// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// gegs sel mdo 'gag gnad bsdus pa// zab las yang zab gdams 'di'ang*// 'jig rten gsum mgon thugs mtsho las// bab pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rang bzo'i rnyog pas ma bslad par// bdag blo'i 'bab stegs la gzhol ba// dri med shog dkar do ra ru// yi ge'i 'o mtsho rgyas byas kyi// skal ldan ngang mo'i tshogs rnams kun// dga' ba'i mgrin rnga sgrog pa dang*// mos pa'i gshog yang deng bskyod cig
/ces pa'ang 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung*// chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
